UN Panel Accuses US of War Crimes in Iran Strike

A United Nations panel has stated there are "reasonable grounds" to believe the United States committed war crimes during two strikes in Iran. The panel's findings specifically mention a strike on an Iranian school. The U.S. has allowed an Iranian delegation to attend a UN assembly despite the ongoing conflict. The same UN panel also blamed the Iranian government for "gross human rights violations and crimes against humanity," including recent violent crackdowns.
